Valid codes: org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, report:view. Duplicate codes in request are deduplicated.

IErpHrmRolePermission.IBulkUpdate.description: Request body for bulk updating role permissions. Contains an array of permission codes to assign to the role. An empty array clears all permissions from the role.
IErpHrmRolePermission.IBulkUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps the permissions array to individual role_permission records in the junction table. Role identified via path parameter roleId. Operation: Transaction that deletes all existing role_permissions for the role and inserts new entries for each permission in the array. Empty array clears all permissions. Valid permission codes validated: org:manage, employee:manage, employee:view, project:manage, project:view, time:manage, time:approve, time:view_all, report:view.

name.description: The role name to validate for availability in the current organization. Must be unique (case-insensitive) within the organization scope and cannot match any built-in role name.
name.x-autobe-specification: Validation input for server-side uniqueness check against erp_hrm_roles.name (case-insensitive) and built-in role name conflict check ('owner', 'manager', 'employee'). This DTO does not persist data; it queries the database to validate the proposed name.

IErpHrmRole.IValidationRequest.description: Request body for validating a role name before creation. Contains the role name to check for availability within the current organization context. The validation checks if the name is unique within the organization and does not conflict with built-in role names (Owner, Manager, Employee).
IErpHrmRole.IValidationRequest.x-autobe-specification: Non-table validation request DTO. The 'name' property carries the proposed role name for server-side validation. Implementation must: 1) Query erp_hrm_roles table for case-insensitive match on name within current organization, 2) Check if name matches built-in role names ('owner', 'manager', 'employee') case-insensitively, 3) Return validation result with isValid flag and error messages.

assignee.x-autobe-specification: Nullable FK mapped to erp_hrm_employee_id column. Returns IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary when task has assignee, null otherwise.
assignee.description: Employee assigned to this task. Returns assignee details when assigned, null when unassigned.

IErpHrmTask.ISummary.description: Lightweight task summary for list display, containing essential fields and assignee information.
IErpHrmTask.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct fields: id, title, status, priority, due_date, created_at. Relations: assignee via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees. Project context provided by path parameter projectId. Excludes: description (HAS-MANY large text), estimated_hours (detail field), subtasks/taskHistories/timelogs/timers (HAS-MANY compositions), erp_hrm_project_id (already scoped by endpoint), erp_hrm_employee_id (replaced by assignee ISummary), parent_id (use separate endpoint for subtask hierarchy).

limit.description: Maximum number of timer records to return per page.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control - maximum number of timer records to return per page. Valid range: 1-100. Default handled by service layer. Maps to LIMIT clause in database query.

page.description: Page number to retrieve (1-indexed).
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control - page number to retrieve (1-indexed). Maps to OFFSET clause: OFFSET = (page - 1) * limit.

project_id.description: UUID of the project to filter timer records by.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Filter timers by project. JOINs erp_hrm_timers.erp_hrm_project_id to erp_hrm_projects.id. Optional - if not provided, returns timers from all projects.

search.description: Search text to filter timers by description.
search.x-autobe-specification: Full-text search filter on timer description. Uses ILIKE/LIKE pattern matching on erp_hrm_timers.description. Optional filter.

status.description: Status filter for timer records ('running' or 'stopped'). Note: stopped timers are converted to timelogs and removed.
status.x-autobe-specification: Filter by timer status. Runtime logic: 'running' returns timers WHERE id exists in erp_hrm_timers; 'stopped' returns empty (timers are deleted when converted to timelogs). No DB column maps directly - this is computed logic. If not provided, returns all timers (typically running only since stopped timers don't persist).

IErpHrmTimer.IRequest.description: Query parameters for retrieving timer records belonging to the authenticated employee. Supports pagination and filtering by project, status, and search text.
IErpHrmTimer.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter DTO for filtering timer records. Authentication: employee_id resolved from JWT session. Filters applied via specification: project_id (JOIN to erp_hrm_projects), status (runtime logic - running timers exist in DB, stopped timers don't), search (ILIKE on description). Pagination: page, limit. Result sorted by started_at descending. This is a non-table type - no direct databaseSchema mapping.

isValid.description: Indicates whether the role name is valid and available for use.
isValid.x-autobe-specification: Computed boolean: true if no validation errors found (no built-in name conflict AND no duplicate name in current organization). False if any validation failure exists.

errors.description: Array of error messages describing validation failures. Empty array when isValid is true.
errors.x-autobe-specification: Computed array of human-readable error messages. Each element describes a validation failure: 'Role name is reserved' for built-in name conflicts, or 'Role name already exists in organization' for duplicates. Empty array when isValid is true.

IErpHrmRole.IValidationResult.description: Validation result for checking role name availability in the current organization.
IErpHrmRole.IValidationResult.x-autobe-specification: Computed response type for role name validation. The server validates the proposed role name against: 1) Built-in role names (owner, manager, employee - case-insensitive), 2) Existing role names in the current organization (case-insensitive uniqueness check via erp_hrm_roles.name). Returns isValid=true and empty errors array when all checks pass.

discard.description: When true, discards the timer without creating a timelog entry. When false (default), creates a timelog entry with the calculated duration.
discard.x-autobe-specification: Optional user-provided flag. When true (discard = true), the backend deletes the timer without creating any timelog entry. When false or omitted (discard = false), the backend calculates duration from started_at to current time and creates a timelog entry with the calculated duration. Backend determines which timer to stop via JWT session context.

IErpHrmTimer.IStop.description: Request body for stopping an employee's active timer. The optional discard flag determines whether to discard the timer without creating a timelog entry.
IErpHrmTimer.IStop.x-autobe-specification: Stop timer request body. The timer to stop is determined by the authenticated employee's active timer from JWT session context. Backend queries erp_hrm_timers for the timer matching the session employee_id. User provides only the optional discard flag.

personalMetrics.description: Personal time tracking metrics for the authenticated employee, including hours logged today and this week, active timer status, recent time entries, pending timesheet for the current week, and assigned tasks with open or in-progress status.
personalMetrics.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate from: erp_hrm_timelogs (hours_today, hours_this_week, recent_timelogs), erp_hrm_timers (active_timer), erp_hrm_timesheets (pending_timesheet), erp_hrm_tasks (assigned_tasks). Always returned for authenticated users. Join via erp_hrm_employee_id from session context.

organizationalMetrics.description: Organizational overview metrics available only to users with report:view permission, showing aggregate statistics about employees, time tracking, pending approvals, high-budget projects, and top performers.
organizationalMetrics.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate from: erp_hrm_employees (active_employee_count), erp_hrm_timelogs (total_hours_this_week), erp_hrm_timesheets (pending_approval_count), erp_hrm_projects (budget_utilization_over_80_percent), erp_hrm_timelogs with erp_hrm_employees (top_5_performers). Scoped to current organization from session context. Only included when report:view permission exists.

IErpHrmDashboard.description: Dashboard response containing personal metrics for all authenticated users and organizational metrics for users with report:view permission.
IErpHrmDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated response computed from multiple database tables. Personal metrics always included for authenticated member users. Organizational metrics conditionally included only when user has report:view permission in the current organization context. Queries include: erp_hrm_timelogs (hours calculations), erp_hrm_timers (active timer status), erp_hrm_timesheets (pending week timesheet), erp_hrm_tasks (assigned open/in-progress tasks).

IErpHrmRole.description: Organization-scoped role defining a named set of permissions for employee access control.
IErpHrmRole.x-autobe-specification: Maps to erp_hrm_roles table. Direct: id, name, is_builtin, timestamps, deleted_at. Belongs-To: organization via erp_hrm_organizations JOIN. Has-Many: rolePermissions via erp_hrm_role_permissions junction table. ICreate: name + permissions array. IUpdate: name (optional) + permissions (required, full replacement per spec).

startDate.description: Start date of the report date range (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
startDate.x-autobe-specification: Start date for filtering erp_hrm_timelogs.date (inclusive). Used to define the beginning of the date range for the weekly summary aggregation. Only complete weeks starting from this date are included.

endDate.description: End date of the report date range (inclusive). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
endDate.x-autobe-specification: End date for filtering erp_hrm_timelogs.date (inclusive). Used to define the end of the date range for the weekly summary aggregation. Only complete weeks ending by this date are included.

projectId.description: Optional project UUID to filter the report to a specific project.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Optional project filter using erp_hrm_project_id from erp_hrm_timelogs. When provided, only timelogs belonging to this project are included in the aggregation. The project must belong to the current organization context.

page.description: Target page number to retrieve (0-indexed). Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 0.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided or null. Controls which page of weekly summary results to return. Total pages calculated based on number of complete weeks in date range.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Controls how many records are included in each page response.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of weekly summary records per page. Defaults to 100 if not provided or null. The server may enforce upper bounds to prevent excessive resource consumption.

IErpHrmWeeklySummary.IRequest.description: Request parameters for the weekly summary report including date range and optional project filter.
IErpHrmWeeklySummary.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering erp_hrm_timelogs aggregation for weekly summary report. Start date and end date define the inclusive date range for querying timelogs. ProjectId optionally filters to a specific project. Page and limit control pagination of results. No direct database table mapping - this is a query/request DTO.

organizationId.description: The unique identifier of the organization to switch to. The user must have an active employee record in this organization.
organizationId.x-autobe-specification: References erp_hrm_organizations.id. The value is user-provided (from request body) and represents the target organization to switch context to. Backend validates: 1) organization with given ID exists, 2) authenticated user has active employee record in that organization. Session is updated to reflect new organization context.

IErpHrmOrganizationContext.ICreate.description: Request body to set the active organization context for the current session. Allows authenticated users who belong to multiple organizations to switch between them. All subsequent API operations are scoped to the newly selected organization.
IErpHrmOrganizationContext.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Utility DTO for session context switching. The organizationId property references erp_hrm_organizations.id - the target organization the authenticated member wants to switch to. Backend validation: 1) organization with given ID must exist, 2) authenticated user must have active employee record in that organization. No database table directly mapped; this is a session context request DTO.

IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary.description: Lightweight timesheet summary for list displays, showing status, hours, and key dates.
IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: SELECT id, week_start_date, week_end_date, status, total_hours, submitted_at, reviewed_at, rejection_reason, created_at, erp_hrm_employee_id, erp_hrm_reviewer_employee_id FROM erp_hrm_timesheets. JOIN erp_hrm_employees for employee.ISummary. JOIN erp_hrm_employees for reviewerEmployee.ISummary. Exclude deleted_at and timesheetTimelogs from summary.

organization.description: The selected organization as a summary object with id, name, currency, timezone, owner, and timestamps.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Computed relation: JOIN erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id TO erp_hrm_organizations.id. Returns embedded ISummary with: id, name, description, logo_uri, currency, timezone, created_at, and nested owner member (erp_hrm_members via owner_id FK).

employee.description: The employee's record in the selected organization containing position, employment type, status, timestamps, assigned role, and department.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Computed from erp_hrm_employees table WHERE member_id = authenticated user AND erp_hrm_organization_id = selected org. Returns IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary with nested role and department objects.

permissions.description: Array of permission codes (e.g., 'org:manage', 'time:approve') assigned to the employee's role in this organization.
permissions.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SELECT rp.permission_code FROM erp_hrm_role_permissions rp WHERE rp.erp_hrm_role_id = employee.role_id. Maps role_permissions.permission_code values to string array. Not a direct column; extracted from role_permissions relation.

IErpHrmOrganizationContext.description: Organization context response containing organization details, employee information, and role permissions for the current session. This is a computed session context DTO returned after switching organization context via POST /erpHrm/member/organization-context.
IErpHrmOrganizationContext.x-autobe-specification: No direct database table. Computed session context returned after organization context switch. Data flow: 1) Member provides organization_id in ICreate, 2) Backend verifies member has active employee record in that organization, 3) JOIN erp_hrm_employees ON erp_hrm_members.id = erp_hrm_employees.member_id WHERE erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId, 4) JOIN erp_hrm_organizations ON erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id = erp_hrm_organizations.id, 5) JOIN erp_hrm_roles ON erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_role_id = erp_hrm_roles.id, 6) JOIN erp_hrm_role_permissions ON erp_hrm_roles.id = erp_hrm_role_permissions.erp_hrm_role_id to get permission strings.

email.description: Email address of the person being invited to join the organization.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.email column. RFC 5322 compliant email validation required. Unique constraint within organization scope (enforced at bulk processing level).

erpHrmRoleId.description: Pre-assigned role identifier for the invited employee.
erpHrmRoleId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_role_id column. Optional pre-assignment of role for invited employee. If null, defaults to organization's default Employee role during processing.

erpHrmDepartmentId.description: Pre-assigned department identifier for the invited employee.
erpHrmDepartmentId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_department_id column. Optional pre-assignment of department. Can be null if department assignment deferred to later.

position.description: Pre-specified position or job title for the invited employee.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.position column. Optional job title or position for the invited employee. Free-form text, no validation constraints.

note.description: Optional message from the organization to the invited person.
note.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.note column. Optional message from organization to the invited person. Stored as text, displayed in invitation email.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when this invitation expires and becomes invalid.
expiresAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations.expires_at column. Optional expiration timestamp for the invitation. If null, invitation does not expire. ISO 8601 format required (date-time).

IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreate.description: Single invitation item within a bulk invitation request. Contains email address and optional pre-assignments for role, department, position, and expiration.
IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps individual invitation items to erp_hrm_invitations table columns. Organization ID resolved from authenticated session context (admin actor). Role and department are optional pre-assignments via foreign key references. System-managed fields (id, status, token, timestamps) excluded.

id.description: Unique identifier of the invitation record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.id. UUID primary key.

email.description: Email address of the person invited to join the organization.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.email. Email address used to identify and match invitations to registering users.

status.description: Current status of the invitation: pending (awaiting registration), accepted (user joined), or expired (no longer valid).
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.status. String values: 'pending', 'accepted', 'expired'. Client should handle all values gracefully.

position.description: Pre-specified position or job title assigned to the invited employee, if any.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.position. Nullable - only present if organization pre-specified a position during invitation.

note.description: Optional message from the organization to the invited person.
note.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.note. Nullable - optional personal message included with invitation.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when this invitation expires and becomes invalid. Null if invitation does not expire.
expiresAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.expires_at. Date-time format. Nullable - if set, invitation becomes invalid after this timestamp.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

organization.description: Organization that sent this invitation, containing name and basic details.
organization.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_organization_id → erp_hrm_organizations.id. Returns IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary with name, currency, timezone, and owner details.

role.description: Pre-assigned role for the invited employee, if any. Null if no role was pre-specified.
role.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_role_id → erp_hrm_roles.id. Nullable - returns IErpHrmRole.ISummary with name, isBuiltin flag, and permission count.

department.description: Pre-assigned department for the invited employee, if any. Null if no department was pre-specified.
department.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_department_id → erp_hrm_departments.id. Nullable - returns IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary with name, description, and parent hierarchy.

IErpHrmInvitation.IVerifyResponse.description: Invitation verification response containing invitation details when the token is valid and invitation is still pending. Returns organization, role, and department context for the invited email.
IErpHrmInvitation.IVerifyResponse.x-autobe-specification: Read DTO for invitation token verification. Maps invitation entity with JOINs to organization, role, and department for contextual display. Token is validated server-side via path parameter, not exposed in response. Excludes internal timestamps (updated_at, deleted_at) and soft-delete indicators.

IErpHrmTimesheet.description: Weekly timesheet entity representing a work week (Monday-Sunday) containing time entries for approval workflow. Includes employee owner, associated timelogs, and reviewer information when approved or rejected.
IErpHrmTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: erp_hrm_timesheets: id, week_start_date, week_end_date, status, total_hours, submitted_at, reviewed_at, rejection_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. JOIN erp_hrm_employees for employee info (id, position). JOIN erp_hrm_employees for reviewer info when not null. JOIN erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs to include associated timelogs.

employees_count.description: Total number of active employees in the organization.
employees_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT() from erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = current_org AND status = 'active'. Returns integer count of active employees in the organization.

high_utilization_projects.description: Projects where budget utilization has exceeded 80 percent.
high_utilization_projects.x-autobe-specification: JOIN erp_hrm_projects with erp_hrm_timelogs, filter WHERE budget_hours > 0 AND (SUM(duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours) * 100 >= 80. Returns array of IHighUtilizationProject with name, color, budget_hours, and utilization_percentage. Limited to 10 results sorted by utilization descending.

pending_timesheets_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT() from erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = current_org AND status = 'submitted'. Returns integer count of timesheets awaiting approval.

top_employees.description: Top five employees ranked by hours logged during the current week.
top_employees.x-autobe-specification: JOIN erp_hrm_employees with erp_hrm_timelogs, filter WHERE timelog date within current Monday-Sunday week. GROUP BY employee, SUM(duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours. JOIN with erp_hrm_departments for department name. ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5. Returns array of ITopEmployee with name, department, and hours.

weekly_hours.description: Total hours logged this week across all employees.
weekly_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 from erp_hrm_timelogs JOIN erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = current_org AND timelog date within current Monday-Sunday week. Returns total hours as floating-point number.

IErpHrmStatistic.description: Aggregated organization statistics for admin dashboard including employee count, weekly hours logged, pending timesheets, high-utilization projects, and top performing employees.
IErpHrmStatistic.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated dashboard statistics combining data from erp_hrm_employees (active count), erp_hrm_timelogs (weekly hours), erp_hrm_timesheets (pending count), and erp_hrm_projects (budget utilization). All metrics are computed for the current organization context within the Monday-Sunday week boundary.

projectIds.description: Optional list of project IDs to include in budget analysis. When provided, only projects matching these IDs will be returned.
projectIds.x-autobe-specification: Optional array of UUIDs filtering erp_hrm_projects.id. When provided, only projects matching these IDs are included in results. If omitted/null, all projects with configured budget_hours are returned. Source: erp_hrm_projects.id WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND budget_hours > 0.

page.description: Target page number to retrieve (1-indexed). Specifies which page of results to return.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if omitted, null, or undefined. Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1. Requesting a page beyond available range returns empty data array with valid pagination metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Controls how many records are included in each page response.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum records per page for pagination. Defaults to 100 if omitted, null, or undefined. Controls how many records are included in each page response. Server may enforce upper bounds to prevent excessive resource consumption.

IErpHrmBudgetAnalysis.IRequest.description: Request body for filtering budget utilization analytics. Supports optional project ID filtering and pagination controls.
IErpHrmBudgetAnalysis.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query filter for budget analytics endpoint. Source: erp_hrm_projects table with budget_hours > 0, joined with erp_hrm_timelogs for actual hours calculation. When projectIds provided, filter projects by those IDs. Pagination parameters page/limit control result paging. All data scoped to authenticated user's organization via middleware.

employeeCount.description: Total number of active employees in the organization.
employeeCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT aggregation from erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId AND status = 'active'. Returns total number of active employees in the organization.

totalHoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged across all employees for the current week.
totalHoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 from erp_hrm_timelogs JOIN erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId AND timelog date falls within current week (Monday to Sunday based on organization timezone). Returns total hours as decimal number.

pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT from erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id IN (employee IDs for current organization) AND status = 'submitted'. Returns count of timesheets awaiting manager approval.

budgetAlertProjects.description: Projects where budget utilization exceeds 80 percent.
budgetAlertProjects.x-autobe-specification: Join erp_hrm_projects with timelog aggregates. Calculate actual_hours = SUM(duration_minutes)/60 per project. Calculate budget_utilization_percentage = (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100. Filter: budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND status = 'active' AND percentage > 80. Returns array of IErpHrmProject.ISummary with budget alerts.

topPerformers.description: Top 5 employees by hours logged this week.
topPerformers.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate timelogs per employee for current week: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours. Filter by organization context. Order by total_hours DESC. Limit 5. Include employee name and total hours. Returns array of anonymous object { employee_id, employee_name, total_hours }.

IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.description: Organization dashboard with aggregate metrics including employee count, weekly hours logged, pending approvals, budget alerts, and top performers. Admin-only response combining data from employees, timelogs, timesheets, and projects for the currently selected organization context.
IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation response DTO combining metrics from erp_hrm_employees, erp_hrm_timelogs, erp_hrm_timesheets, and erp_hrm_projects. Not a direct table mapping. Compute metrics per operation specification: employeeCount via COUNT, totalHoursThisWeek via SUM(duration_minutes)/60, pendingTimesheetsCount via COUNT WHERE status='submitted', budgetAlertProjects via percentage calculation, topPerformers via per-employee aggregation.

items.description: Array of project budget report items sorted by utilization percentage descending.
items.x-autobe-specification: Array of computed budget utilization entries derived from erp_hrm_projects and erp_hrm_timelogs aggregation. Each entry contains: project id, project name, budget_hours, actual_hours_logged, budget_utilization_percentage, and budget_status. Sorted by budget_utilization_percentage in descending order.

total.description: Total number of projects with budget hours configured.
total.x-autobe-specification: COUNT of projects from erp_hrm_projects where budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND budget_hours > 0. Represents the count of projects included in this budget utilization report.

IErpHrmProject.description: Budget utilization report showing budget consumption metrics for each project with configured budget hours in the organization.
IErpHrmProject.x-autobe-specification: Budget utilization report aggregating data from erp_hrm_projects (budget_hours) and erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes). For each project with budget_hours > 0: actual_hours_logged = SUM(duration_minutes)/60, budget_utilization_percentage = (actual_hours_logged/budget_hours)*100. Budget status derived: over_budget if actual > budget, approaching_budget if utilization >= 80%, otherwise within_budget. Results sorted by budget_utilization_percentage DESC.

totalMemberCount.description: Total number of members assigned to the project.
totalMemberCount.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_project_members WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId. Returns total count of all members assigned to the project regardless of role.

roleBreakdown.description: Breakdown of project members by their assigned role.
roleBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assigned_role = 'member') as member_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE assigned_role = 'project_lead') as project_lead_count FROM erp_hrm_project_members WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId. Returns breakdown counts by role type.

members.description: List of project members with their details and role assignments.
members.x-autobe-specification: SELECT pm.id, pm.assigned_role, pm.created_at, e.position, m.display_name, m.avatar FROM erp_hrm_project_members pm JOIN erp_hrm_employees e ON pm.erp_hrm_employee_id = e.id JOIN erp_hrm_members m ON e.erp_hrm_member_id = m.id WHERE pm.erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId ORDER BY pm.created_at. Each member object references IErpHrmProjectMember.ISummary.

IErpHrmProjectMember.IAnalytic.description: Project member analytics response containing aggregated statistics and detailed member list for a specific project.
IErpHrmProjectMember.IAnalytic.x-autobe-specification: Computed type from JOINs on erp_hrm_project_members, erp_hrm_employees, and erp_hrm_members. Aggregations: COUNT(*) as total_member_count, COUNT by assigned_role (member, project_lead). Member details ordered by created_at. This is an analytics aggregation type, not a direct table mapping.

id.description: Unique department identifier.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_departments.id (UUID primary key).

name.description: Department display name used for identification within the organization.

description.description: Optional description of the department's purpose or responsibilities.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_departments.description. Nullable - departments may not have a description.

parent.description: Parent department reference for hierarchical context. Null indicates a root-level department.
parent.x-autobe-specification: Join via erp_hrm_departments.parent_id → erp_hrm_departments.id. Returns IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary for parent context. Null if this is a root-level department.

children.description: Array of child departments nested under this department for tree rendering.
children.x-autobe-specification: Recursive relation from erp_hrm_departments.children. Each child is IErpHrmDepartment.IHierarchy with same structure. Array may be empty for leaf nodes.

IErpHrmDepartment.IHierarchy.description: Department hierarchy node with nested children for tree structure rendering. Represents a single department with its parent reference and array of child departments for hierarchical UI displays.
IErpHrmDepartment.IHierarchy.x-autobe-specification: Build hierarchy tree server-side from erp_hrm_departments table: fetch all departments for current organization, group by parent_id, nest children under root departments (parent_id=null). Each node includes parent ISummary reference for context. Recursive children array allows unlimited nesting depth. Both active and inactive departments included.

project.description: The project being analyzed, represented as a summary object with essential project details including name, color, status, and organization context.
project.x-autobe-specification: Direct $ref to IErpHrmProject.ISummary. Represents the project entity being analyzed for budget utilization. The project_id comes from erp_hrm_projects.id filtered by budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND budget_hours > 0.

budgetHours.description: Total estimated budget hours configured for the project, sourced directly from the project's budget_hours field.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours. Projects with null or zero budget_hours are excluded from results per operation specification.

actualHours.description: Total hours actually logged against the project, calculated by summing all timelog durations and dividing by 60 to convert minutes to hours.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: JOIN erp_hrm_projects with erp_hrm_timelogs ON erp_hrm_timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id = erp_hrm_projects.id. actualHours = SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60. Only includes timelogs belonging to the authenticated user's organization.

utilizationPercentage.description: Percentage of budget consumed, calculated as a ratio of actual hours to budget hours, expressed as a decimal value rounded to one place.
utilizationPercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed: utilizationPercentage = (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100, rounded to one decimal place. Formula: (SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 / projects.budget_hours) * 100.

oneOf.description: Budget consumption status based on utilization: within_budget (<80%), approaching_budget (80-100%), over_budget (>100%).
Budget consumption status based on utilization: within_budget (<80%), approaching_budget (80-100%), over_budget (>100%).
Budget consumption status based on utilization: within_budget (<80%), approaching_budget (80-100%), over_budget (>100%).

budgetStatus.description: Budget consumption status indicating whether the project is within budget, approaching budget threshold, or has exceeded its allocated hours.
budgetStatus.x-autobe-specification: Computed from utilizationPercentage: 'within_budget' when utilization < 80, 'approaching_budget' when 80 <= utilization <= 100, 'over_budget' when utilization > 100.

IErpHrmBudgetAnalysis.IResult.description: Budget utilization result for a single project with configured budget hours.
IErpHrmBudgetAnalysis.IResult.x-autobe-specification: Budget utilization aggregation computed by joining erp_hrm_projects (filtered by budget_hours > 0) with erp_hrm_timelogs. actualHours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60. utilizationPercentage = (actualHours / budgetHours) * 100, rounded to 1 decimal. Status mapping: <80 = within_budget, 80-100 = approaching_budget, >100 = over_budget. Results ordered by utilizationPercentage DESC.

weekStartDate.description: Start date of the week (Monday) for which time tracking metrics are aggregated.
weekStartDate.x-autobe-specification: Derived date boundary: trunc(timelog_date, 'week') AS week_start. This is the Monday of the week containing the timelog, used as the grouping key for weekly aggregation. Excluded from partial weeks at range boundaries.

weekEndDate.description: End date of the week (Sunday) for which time tracking metrics are aggregated.
weekEndDate.x-autobe-specification: Derived date boundary: week_start + 6 days = Sunday. This is the Sunday of the same week as weekStartDate, defining the complete 7-day week range. Paired with weekStartDate to represent the full week boundary.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged by all employees during this week, calculated as the sum of all timelog durations divided by 60.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0. Aggregates duration_minutes column from all timelogs within the week. Result is a floating-point number representing total billable and non-billable hours combined.

timelogsCount.description: Number of individual timelog entries recorded during this week.
timelogsCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE timelog_date >= weekStartDate AND timelog_date <= weekEndDate. Counts all individual timelog rows within the weekly boundary, including both billable and non-billable entries.

employeesCount.description: Number of distinct employees who logged time during this week.
employeesCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(DISTINCT erp_hrm_timelogs.erp_hrm_employee_id). Counts unique employee IDs among all timelogs within the week. A single employee who logs multiple entries in the same week counts as 1.

IErpHrmWeeklySummary.ISummary.description: Weekly summary containing aggregated time tracking metrics for a complete week (Monday through Sunday), including total hours logged, number of timelog entries, and count of distinct employees who logged time during that week.
IErpHrmWeeklySummary.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from erp_hrm_timelogs table. Week boundary: Monday 00:00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59. Aggregation per week: totalHours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0, timelogsCount = COUNT(*), employeesCount = COUNT(DISTINCT erp_hrm_employee_id). Exclude partial weeks at range boundaries. Order by week start date ascending. No direct table mapping - purely computed aggregation result.

id.description: Unique identifier of the invitation.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.id. UUID primary key.

email.description: Email address of the person invited to join the organization.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.email. The invited person's email address.

status.description: Current status of the invitation indicating whether it is pending, has been accepted, or has expired.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.status. Values: pending, accepted, expired.

token.description: Secure token for the invitation link. Regenerated when invitation is resent.
token.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.token. Secure token regenerated during resend operation. Nullable in DB but always present after resend.

position.description: Pre-specified job title or position for the invited employee. Null if not specified.

note.description: Optional message from the organization included in the invitation. Null if not provided.
note.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.note. Nullable. Optional message from the organization to the invited person.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation was accepted and the employee joined the organization. Null if not yet accepted.
acceptedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.accepted_at. ISO 8601 timestamp. Nullable.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when this invitation expires and becomes invalid. Null if no expiration is set.
expiresAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.expires_at. ISO 8601 timestamp. Nullable.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.created_at. ISO 8601 timestamp.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the invitation was last modified.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.updated_at. ISO 8601 timestamp. Updated when token is regenerated during resend.

deletedAt.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null if the invitation is active.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations.deleted_at. ISO 8601 timestamp. Nullable. Null means active, non-null means soft-deleted.

organization.description: The organization that sent this invitation.
organization.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: JOIN erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_organization_id TO erp_hrm_organizations.id. Returns IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary.

role.description: Pre-assigned role for the invited employee. Null if no role has been pre-assigned.
role.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: JOIN erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_role_id TO erp_hrm_roles.id. Returns IErpHrmRole.ISummary. Nullable.

department.description: Pre-assigned department for the invited employee. Null if no department has been pre-assigned.
department.x-autobe-specification: BELONGS-TO relation: JOIN erp_hrm_invitations.erp_hrm_department_id TO erp_hrm_departments.id. Returns IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary. Nullable.

IErpHrmInvitation.IResendResponse.description: Response containing the updated invitation record after resending. Includes the regenerated invitation token and pre-assigned role/department details for the invited employee.
IErpHrmInvitation.IResendResponse.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_invitations table. Columns: id, email, status, token, position, note, accepted_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Belongs-to relations via JOIN: organization (required), role (nullable), department (nullable). Token included in response as it is regenerated during resend operation.

failures.description: Array of failed invitation attempts from the bulk operation. Each failure contains the email address that could not be processed and the corresponding error details.
failures.x-autobe-specification: Computed array field aggregating failed invitation attempts from bulk processing. Each failure represents one invitation that could not be processed (duplicate email, invalid format, existing employee, etc.). WARNING: items.$ref references IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure which does NOT exist in the schema registry. Downstream Realize agent should either: (1) create IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure schema with { email: string, error: { code: string, message: string } }, OR (2) inline the object definition. Each failure item should contain: email (string, format: idn-email) that failed, and error object with code (string, e.g., 'DUPLICATE_EMAIL', 'INVALID_FORMAT', 'EXISTING_EMPLOYEE') and message (string, human-readable error description).

successes.description: Array of successfully processed invitation results from the bulk operation. Each success contains the created invitation summary including status, email, and any pre-assigned role or department details.
successes.x-autobe-specification: Computed array field aggregating successfully processed invitations from bulk creation. Each success maps to a created invitation or immediate employee addition (when inviting existing user). Items reference IErpHrmInvitation.ISummary which contains: id (UUID), email (idn-email), status ('pending' for new users, 'accepted' for existing users), position (nullable), note (nullable), accepted_at (nullable), expires_at (nullable), created_at (date-time), role (IErpHrmRole.ISummary), department (IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary or null). Direct mapping to erp_hrm_invitations columns via JOIN operations for role and department relations.

IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateResult.description: Bulk operation response containing individual results for each invitation attempt in a bulk invitation creation request. Contains two arrays: successes for successfully processed invitations and failures for invitations that could not be processed.
IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateResult.x-autobe-specification: Computed response type for bulk invitation creation operation. Aggregates results from processing an array of IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreate items. No direct database table mapping - values computed from bulk processing logic. successes: maps to array of IErpHrmInvitation.ISummary for each successfully processed invitation (includes existing-user additions with status='accepted' and pending invitations with status='pending'). failures: references IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure (phantom schema - schema does not exist in system, requires creation or schema reference correction). WARNING: The failures.items.$ref to IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure should be verified - if schema does not exist, create it or use inline object with email (string) and error (object with code string and message string).

items.description: Array of available permissions with their associated role information.
items.x-autobe-specification: Array wrapper returning role-permission mappings. Each item contains permission code, role object (role_id, role_name), and timestamps. Direct mapping to JOIN results from erp_hrm_role_permissions ON erp_hrm_role_id = erp_hrm_roles.id, ordered by permission ASC.

IErpHrmRolePermission.IList.description: List of available permissions with their associated role information. Each item shows a permission code and which role it belongs to.
IErpHrmRolePermission.IList.x-autobe-specification: LIST operation returning array of role-permission mappings from erp_hrm_role_permissions joined with erp_hrm_roles. SELECT permission code, role_id, role_name, created_at, updated_at via JOIN erp_hrm_role_permissions ON erp_hrm_role_id = erp_hrm_roles.id. Order by permission ASC. No pagination as fixed small set.

low.description: Number of tasks with low priority.
low.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND priority = 'low'. Returns integer count of tasks with low priority. Must include 0 when no low-priority tasks exist.

medium.description: Number of tasks with medium priority.
medium.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND priority = 'medium'. Returns integer count of tasks with medium priority. Must include 0 when no medium-priority tasks exist.

high.description: Number of tasks with high priority.
high.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND priority = 'high'. Returns integer count of tasks with high priority. Must include 0 when no high-priority tasks exist.

urgent.description: Number of tasks with urgent priority.
urgent.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND priority = 'urgent'. Returns integer count of tasks with urgent priority. Must include 0 when no urgent-priority tasks exist.

IErpHrmTask.IPriorityBreakdown.description: Task count breakdown by priority level showing number of tasks for each priority (low, medium, high, urgent).
IErpHrmTask.IPriorityBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Aggregation result from erp_hrm_tasks table. SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId GROUP BY priority. Returns an object with integer counts for each priority level (low, medium, high, urgent). All four priority levels must be included in the response with zero (0) when no tasks exist for that priority.

count.description: Number of tasks created on the specific date, aggregated by the grouping query.
count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation result from erp_hrm_tasks table. SQL: SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date. Returns the number of tasks created on each specific date within the 30-day lookback period.

date.description: The specific calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD format) for this aggregated task creation count entry.
date.x-autobe-specification: Derived from erp_hrm_tasks.created_at via DATE() extraction. SQL: SELECT DATE(created_at) as date FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date. Returns date in YYYY-MM-DD string format for each day within the lookback period.

IErpHrmTask.ITemporalTrendItem.description: Temporal trend data point representing daily task creation counts within the last 30 days for analytics and project progress tracking.
IErpHrmTask.ITemporalTrendItem.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from erp_hrm_tasks table. Query: SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date. This produces daily task creation counts for the last 30 days, used in temporal trend analytics within task aggregations.

open.description: Number of tasks with open status.
open.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND status = 'open'. Returns the total count of tasks with open status.

inProgress.description: Number of tasks with in-progress status.
inProgress.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND status = 'in-progress'. Returns the total count of tasks with in-progress status.

completed.description: Number of tasks with completed status.
completed.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND status = 'completed'. Returns the total count of tasks with completed status.

closed.description: Number of tasks with closed status.
closed.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId AND status = 'closed'. Returns the total count of tasks with closed status.

IErpHrmTask.IStatusBreakdown.description: Task count breakdown by workflow status showing the number of tasks in each status category (open, in-progress, completed, closed).
IErpHrmTask.IStatusBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type from erp_hrm_tasks table. Executes COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_project_id = :projectId GROUP BY status. Each property maps to a count of tasks in a specific status value: open, in-progress, completed, closed. Used for project task analytics dashboard widgets.

name.description: Name of the project with high budget utilization.

color.description: Color code for UI display of the project.

budget_hours.description: Configured budget hours for the project.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours. Filter ensures budget_hours > 0.

utilization_percentage.description: Budget utilization percentage calculated as actual logged hours divided by budget hours, multiplied by 100.
utilization_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Calculated aggregation: (SUM(duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours) * 100. Computed from erp_hrm_timelogs duration joined with erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours. Filter: utilization >= 80%.

IErpHrmStatistic.IHighUtilizationProject.description: Project summary with high budget utilization showing the project name, color, configured budget hours, and calculated utilization percentage.
IErpHrmStatistic.IHighUtilizationProject.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from erp_hrm_projects JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs. Filter: budget_hours > 0 AND (SUM(duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours) * 100 >= 80. Properties: name from erp_hrm_projects.name, color from erp_hrm_projects.color, budget_hours from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours, utilization_percentage as calculated value (SUM(duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours) * 100. Limited to 10 results sorted by utilization_percentage DESC.

email.description: Email address of the invitation that failed to process.
email.x-autobe-specification: Email address captured at time of bulk invitation processing failure. Passed through from request context (IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreate.items[].email) for error correlation. Not stored as a separate failure record - only the validation error is recorded.

code.description: Error code identifying the failure reason (e.g., DUPLICATE_EMAIL, INVALID_FORMAT, EXISTING_EMPLOYEE).

message.description: Human-readable error message describing why the invitation failed.

error.description: Error details including a machine-readable code and human-readable message describing why the invitation failed.
error.x-autobe-specification: Computed error object constructed from validation logic during bulk invitation processing. Contains: code (string identifier from validation failure type) and message (human-readable description). No direct database column - assembled from validation rules.

IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure.description: Represents a single failed invitation attempt within a bulk invitation operation, containing the email address that failed and error details.
IErpHrmInvitation.IBulkCreateFailure.x-autobe-specification: Computed error type for bulk invitation failures. No direct database table - constructed from validation logic during bulk processing. Captures: email (idn-email format) that could not be processed, error.code (string identifier like 'DUPLICATE_EMAIL', 'INVALID_FORMAT', 'EXISTING_EMPLOYEE'), error.message (human-readable description). Error codes are case-sensitive string identifiers defined by processing logic.

projectId.x-autobe-specification: Project identifier projected from erp_hrm_projects.id via JOIN on erp_hrm_projects.id. Direct projection of the primary key for budget utilization entry identification.

projectName.x-autobe-specification: Project display name projected from erp_hrm_projects.name via JOIN on erp_hrm_projects.id. Direct projection for budget entry identification.

budgetHours.description: Total estimated hours budgeted for this project.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Total estimated budget hours projected from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours via JOIN on erp_hrm_projects.id. Used as denominator in utilization percentage calculation.

actualHoursLogged.description: Total hours actually logged against this project, calculated from all timelog entries. Rounded to one decimal place.
actualHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: JOIN erp_hrm_projects.id with erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id, then SUM(duration_minutes)/60, rounded to 1 decimal place.

budgetUtilizationPercentage.description: Percentage of budget consumed, calculated as (actual_hours_logged / budget_hours) * 100. Can exceed 100% when over budget.
budgetUtilizationPercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed percentage: (actualHoursLogged / budget_hours) * 100, rounded to 1 decimal place. Can exceed 100% when actual hours exceed budget.

oneOf.description: Budget utilization below 80%.
Budget utilization between 80% and 100%.
Actual hours exceed budget hours.

budgetStatus.description: Budget consumption status derived from utilization percentage and actual vs budget comparison.
budgetStatus.x-autobe-specification: Computed enum derivation: if actualHoursLogged > budget_hours then 'over_budget', else if budgetUtilizationPercentage >= 80 then 'approaching_budget', else 'within_budget'. String type with const enum values.

IErpHrmProject.IEntry.description: Budget utilization entry for a single project showing configured budget hours, actual hours logged, utilization percentage, and budget status indicator.
IErpHrmProject.IEntry.x-autobe-specification: Budget utilization aggregation for projects with configured budget hours. Computed by JOINing erp_hrm_projects with erp_hrm_timelogs on project_id. actual_hours_logged = SUM(duration_minutes)/60 rounded to 1 decimal. budget_utilization_percentage = (actual_hours_logged/budget_hours)*100 rounded to 1 decimal. budget_status: over_budget if actual > budget, approaching_budget if percentage >= 80%, otherwise within_budget.

id.description: Unique employee identifier.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_employees.id. UUID primary key with unique constraint.

position.description: Job title or position of the employee within the organization.
position.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_employees.position. Nullable field for job title or position within the organization.

employmentType.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_employees.employment_type. Enum values: full-time, part-time, contractor, intern.

status.description: Employment status indicating whether the employee can perform time tracking operations.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_employees.status. Enum values: active (can log time), deactivated (historical data preserved but cannot perform operations).

member.description: The user account associated with this employee record, containing display name, email, and avatar.
member.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_member_id to erp_hrm_members.id. Returns IErpHrmMember.ISummary containing user account details: email, display_name, avatar_uri.

role.description: The role assigned to this employee determining their permissions in the organization.
role.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_role_id to erp_hrm_roles.id. Returns IErpHrmRole.ISummary containing role details: name, is_builtin, and organization context.

department.description: Optional department the employee belongs to for organizational grouping.
department.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_department_id to erp_hrm_departments.id. Returns IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary containing department details: name, description, parent. Nullable relation.

IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary.description: Lightweight employee summary for association references in contracts, project memberships, timelogs, timesheets, and timers. Contains essential identity fields plus nested member, role, and department context.
IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Maps erp_hrm_employees table for lightweight employee summaries used in association references (contracts, project memberships, timelogs, timesheets, timers). SELECT with JOINs: erp_hrm_member_id → erp_hrm_members.id (IErpHrmMember.ISummary), erp_hrm_role_id → erp_hrm_roles.id (IErpHrmRole.ISummary), erp_hrm_department_id → erp_hrm_departments.id (IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary, nullable). FK scalar columns excluded, replaced by nested ISummary objects. Timestamps and organization_id excluded (scoped by session).

id.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet-timelog association record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.id. UUID primary key generated when the association is created.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the timelog was added to the timesheet.
addedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.added_at. Timestamp when the timelog was added to the timesheet via the management endpoint.

timelog.description: Full timelog entity with date, duration, project, task, description, and billable status.
timelog.x-autobe-specification: JOIN via erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.erp_hrm_timelog_id to erp_hrm_timelogs.id. Returns full IErpHrmTimelog entity with date, duration_minutes, description, billable flag, and embedded employee/project/task summaries.

IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.description: Junction entity representing a single timelog entry associated with a timesheet. Contains the association metadata (when added) and the full timelog details including date, duration, project, task, description, and billable status.
IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.x-autobe-specification: Maps the junction table linking timesheets to timelogs. Direct columns: id (UUID primary key), added_at (timestamp when timelog was added). FK relations: erp_hrm_timesheet_id excluded (parent context implicit from containing IErpHrmTimesheet.timesheetTimelogs array), erp_hrm_timelog_id excluded (FK column replaced by nested IErpHrmTimelog object exposed via timelog property, JOIN on erp_hrm_timelog_id → erp_hrm_timelogs.id).

hoursToday.description: Total minutes logged by the employee today.
hoursToday.x-autobe-specification: SUM(duration_minutes) from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND date = current_date. Returns total minutes logged today by the authenticated employee.

hoursThisWeek.description: Total minutes logged by the employee this week (Monday to Sunday).
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM(duration_minutes) from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND week containing current_date (Monday to Sunday). Returns total minutes logged this week by the authenticated employee.

activeTimer.description: Currently running timer for the authenticated employee. Null if no timer is active.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Single row from erp_hrm_timers WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND timer has no associated timelog (timer still running). Returns IErpHrmTimer.ISummary when active timer exists, null otherwise.

recentTimelogs.description: The 5 most recent timelog entries for the authenticated employee.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Last 5 rows from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id ORDER BY created_at DESC. Returns array of IErpHrmTimelog.ISummary objects.

pendingTimesheet.description: The timesheet for the current week if it exists as draft or submitted. Null if no timesheet has been created.
pendingTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Single row from erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND week_start_date = current Monday AND status IN ('draft', 'submitted'). Returns IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary when timesheet exists, null otherwise.

assignedTasks.description: Tasks assigned to the employee with status 'open' or 'in-progress'.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: Rows from erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') ORDER BY due_date ASC, priority DESC. Returns array of IErpHrmTask.ISummary objects.

IErpHrmDashboard.IPersonalMetric.description: Personal time tracking metrics for the authenticated employee, including hours logged today and this week, active timer status, recent time entries, pending timesheet for the current week, and assigned tasks with open or in-progress status.
IErpHrmDashboard.IPersonalMetric.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from multiple tables for personal dashboard metrics. hoursToday: SUM(duration_minutes) from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND date = current_date. hoursThisWeek: SUM(duration_minutes) from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND week containing current_date. activeTimer: Single row from erp_hrm_timers WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND no associated timelog (timer still running). recentTimelogs: Last 5 rows from erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id ORDER BY created_at DESC. pendingTimesheet: Single row from erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND week_start_date = current Monday AND status IN ('draft', 'submitted'). assignedTasks: Rows from erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = session.employee_id AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress').

activeEmployeeCount.description: Count of employees with active status in the current organization.
activeEmployeeCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL. Scoped to current organization from session context.

totalHoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged by all employees this week (Monday 00:00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59).
totalHoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0 FROM erp_hrm_timelogs timelogs JOIN erp_hrm_employees employees ON timelogs.erp_hrm_employee_id = employees.id WHERE employees.erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId AND timelogs.date >= :weekStartMonday AND timelogs.date <= :weekEndSunday. Uses current server week boundaries (Monday-Sunday).

pendingApprovalCount.description: Number of timesheets in 'submitted' status awaiting manager approval.
pendingApprovalCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) FROM erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId) AND status = 'submitted'. Counts all submitted timesheets owned by employees in the current organization.

budgetUtilizationOver80Percent.description: List of projects where logged hours exceed 80% of their configured budget hours.
budgetUtilizationOver80Percent.x-autobe-specification: SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.budget_hours, SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 AS actual_hours FROM erp_hrm_projects projects JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs timelogs ON projects.id = timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id WHERE projects.erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId AND projects.budget_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY projects.id HAVING SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 >= (projects.budget_hours * 0.8). Excludes projects with null budget_hours.

top5Performers.description: Top 5 employees ranked by total hours logged this week, showing employee name and hours.
top5Performers.x-autobe-specification: SELECT employees.id, members.display_name, SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 AS hours FROM erp_hrm_employees employees JOIN erp_hrm_members members ON employees.erp_hrm_member_id = members.id JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs timelogs ON employees.id = timelogs.erp_hrm_employee_id WHERE employees.erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId AND timelogs.date >= :weekStartMonday AND timelogs.date <= :weekEndSunday GROUP BY employees.id, members.display_name ORDER BY hours DESC LIMIT 5. Uses current server week boundaries.

IErpHrmDashboard.IOrganizationalMetric.description: Organizational dashboard metrics showing aggregate statistics about employees, time tracking activity, pending approvals, high-budget projects, and top performers for the current organization.
IErpHrmDashboard.IOrganizationalMetric.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation DTO with no direct database table mapping. All properties are computed from multiple tables using aggregation queries scoped to the current organization from session context. Calculates: employee count, weekly hours, pending approvals, high-budget projects, and top performers.

name.x-autobe-specification: JOIN erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_member_id to erp_hrm_members.id, then extract erp_hrm_members.display_name. This is the employee's global profile display name from the members table.

department.x-autobe-specification: JOIN erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_department_id to erp_hrm_departments.id, then extract erp_hrm_departments.name. Nullable if employee has no department assignment.
department.description: Employee's department name. Null if employee has no department assignment.

hours.description: Total hours logged during the current week.
hours.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate from erp_hrm_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours. Filter by date within current Monday-Sunday week. GROUP BY employee. This is a computed value representing total logged hours.

IErpHrmStatistic.ITopEmployee.description: Top employee ranked by hours logged during the current week, showing the employee's name, department, and total hours.
IErpHrmStatistic.ITopEmployee.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from JOIN erp_hrm_employees with erp_hrm_members (display_name), erp_hrm_departments (name), and erp_hrm_timelogs aggregation. Filter timelogs by date within current Monday-Sunday week. GROUP BY employee, SUM(duration_minutes)/60 as total_hours. ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5.

id.description: Unique identifier of the project.
id.x-autobe-specification: Project identifier from aggregation query: SELECT projects.id FROM erp_hrm_projects JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs ON projects.id = timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id WHERE projects.budget_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY projects.id.

name.x-autobe-specification: Project name from aggregation query: SELECT projects.name FROM erp_hrm_projects JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE projects.budget_hours IS NOT NULL.

budgetHours.description: Total estimated hours allocated for the project.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Budget hours from aggregation query: SELECT projects.budget_hours FROM erp_hrm_projects WHERE projects.budget_hours IS NOT NULL.

actualHours.description: Total hours actually logged against this project, calculated by summing all timelog durations in minutes and dividing by 60.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Aggregated computation: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 FROM erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id = projects.id. This field is computed from the JOIN between erp_hrm_projects and erp_hrm_timelogs tables, grouped by project. Only projects with budget_hours configured and actual hours >= 80% of budget threshold are included.

IErpHrmDashboard.IBudgetUtilizationItem.description: Budget utilization metrics for a single project showing configured budget hours versus actual hours logged, enabling budget tracking and alert visualization on the organization dashboard.
IErpHrmDashboard.IBudgetUtilizationItem.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation result from query: SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.budget_hours, SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 AS actual_hours FROM erp_hrm_projects projects JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs timelogs ON projects.id = timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id WHERE projects.erp_hrm_organization_id = :organizationId AND projects.budget_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY projects.id HAVING SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 >= (projects.budget_hours * 0.8). Properties: id (projects.id), name (projects.name), budgetHours (projects.budget_hours), actualHours (computed SUM aggregated from timelogs). All fields required - this type only contains projects that exceeded 80% threshold.

displayName.x-autobe-specification: Derived from erp_hrm_members.display_name column via JOIN with erp_hrm_employees. Part of aggregation query: SELECT members.display_name.

employeeId.x-autobe-specification: Derived from erp_hrm_employees.id column via JOIN with erp_hrm_members. Part of aggregation query: SELECT employees.id.

hours.description: Total hours logged by the employee this week, calculated as sum of duration_minutes divided by 60.
hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60.0 from erp_hrm_timelogs. Grouped by employee, scoped to current organization and current week (Monday-Sunday).

IErpHrmDashboard.ITopPerformer.description: Top employee performer ranked by total hours logged during the current week.
IErpHrmDashboard.ITopPerformer.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from erp_hrm_employees (id), erp_hrm_members (display_name), and erp_hrm_timelogs (SUM duration_minutes/60.0). Scoped to current organization via erp_hrm_organization_id. Filters to current week (Monday-Sunday). Groups by employee, orders by hours DESC, limits to 5 results.
